title: Business Management + Administration Cluster Exam
placeholderNote: Only 7 openly licensed questions are cleared for this exam, all from one BCcampus book (CC BY 4.0), so most instructional areas are empty. 94 more questions from OpenStax books (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) are held in _hold-openstax/exams/business-management.json until OpenStax gives written permission (its books forbid use in AI offerings) or the owner decides to ship them. No other open, publicly keyed 4-choice source was found for Operations, Strategic, Knowledge, Project or Quality Management, Communications, Professional Development or Economics (see sourcesChecked). Do not fill the gaps with AI-written questions.
blurb: Practice questions reused from an openly licensed textbook, grouped by the Business Management + Administration exam's instructional areas.
disclaimer: Questions reused from openly licensed sources (credited on each question). Not official DECA exam content.
licenceNote: All questions come from Introduction to Tourism and Hospitality in BC - 2nd Edition (BCcampus), CC BY 4.0. Show each question's attribution line with it. Credit BCcampus and the editors by name only: no logos, no suggestion of endorsement. The book has no AI-use clause.
selectionNote: Only items whose correct answer is published in the source (H5P answer data) and that have 4 choices (or 5 trimmed to 4) were used. Items were left out when they are true/false, have 3 choices, accept several answers, or are tourism-only trivia. Risk-process steps three and four (H5P 40, questions 3-4) were left out on purpose: their stems repeat steps one and two, and placing "risk control" before "risk treatment" is specific to the book's model, so one defensible answer is not guaranteed for a student who learned another model.
formatNote: Wording is the source's own, typos included ("Step one the risk management process is:", "injuried", "do what ever", "worplace"). Choice order is the source's order. H5P Single Choice Sets store the correct answer first and shuffle on display, so the app should shuffle choices. bma-101 was cut from 5 to 4 choices (adapted: true).
difficultyNote: difficulty is an estimate, not an expert rating: 1 = recall of one stated fact, 2 = several facts to weigh.
explanationNote: explanationFrom "source-text" = the explanation quotes, word for word, the book section the item comes from (and the H5P activity's own feedback where it has one). Each quote was checked against the section page by script.
idNote: IDs bma-001 to bma-097 belong to the held OpenStax set's numbering (bma-079, bma-084 and bma-085 were already BCcampus items in it). New BCcampus items start at bma-098 so the held set can be merged back without renumbering.

verification.verifier: independent answer-key and licence check (second pass)
notes: Each of the 7 items was solved blind before its key was read; all 7 blind answers matched the stored key.

Live H5P data was fetched from the four cited chapter pages on opentextbc.ca on 2026-10-11 (H5P ids 40, 41, 42, 44, 54 are embedded there). A script compared stems, choices, choice order and keys: all match apart from HTML/whitespace. bma-101 differs only by the documented removal of "Figure out who to blame" (adapted: true, noted in its attribution).
Each key is unique in the source data: the MultiChoice items (41, 44 and 54 q1) have exactly one correct:true answer; the SingleChoiceSet items (40 q1-2, 42 q1-2) store the correct answer first.

Licence confirmed on each cited page footer: "Introduction to Tourism and Hospitality in BC - 2nd Edition Copyright © 2015, 2020, 2021 by Morgan Westcott and Wendy Anderson is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License, except where otherwise noted." H5P metadata: ids 40, 41, 42, 44 = CC BY 4.0, author Blake Rowsell; id 54 = "U" with no author, embedded in 13.3 with no separate notice, so the book's grant covers it. No AI-use or other restricting clause on the home or chapter pages.

Attribution checked: the book home page asks for "Introduction to Tourism and Hospitality in BC - 2nd Edition by Wendy Anderson and Morgan Westcott (Editors) is used under a CC BY 4.0 Licence." plus "Download for free from the B.C. Open Collection."; every item's line carries that text verbatim and also names the activity, its author where one is given, the section, publisher, URL and licence link (full TASL).
Every quote in the explanations was found word for word on the cited chapter page or in the H5P feedback.

Ambiguity reviewed and kept: bma-085's distractor "Transfers the acceptance of negligence" is not the waiver's purpose (the book defines it as transferring acceptance of risk; a waiver releases claims, it does not move negligence). bma-084/bma-098: some models (e.g. ISO 31000) add context-setting or evaluation steps, but among the four offered choices identification is first and analysis second in every common model.

Flag for owner, kept: bma-100 needs BC-specific knowledge (WorkSafeBC). Its key is still the only defensible answer, since go2HR does BC tourism safety training but does not pay wage-loss compensation.

Duplicates: none within this file. All 7 items also appear in hospitality-tourism.json (ht-016, ht-029, ht-081, ht-082, ht-083, ht-094, ht-095), and 3 appear in entrepreneurship.json (ent-096 to ent-098: WorkSafeBC and risk steps one and two). They were kept because each exam is its own practice set; dedupe by stem if the app ever mixes exams.
Answer positions: 5 of 7 keys are index 0 because H5P Single Choice Sets store the correct answer first. The app must shuffle choices, as formatNote says.
No questions were added. The builder's earlier check is kept under buildVerification.
